changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Tetris', 'Stack falling tetrominoes and clear lines. Single-player; runs entirely in your browser.', 'tetris', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'tetris'); INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Tetris', 'A 10x20 well. Rotate and drop pieces; clear lines to score.', 'tetris', 'tetris', 1, '/api/assets/levels/tetris/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'tetris'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'tetris');
